routes.serves: note list JSON that feeds the home page notes area (pinned notes and regular notes)
create a note from the Take a note editor (title + content); returns 201 with the created note, 400 on invalid JSON body

notes: REQ-2.2: clicking the collapsed "Take a note" form (a single-line textbox carrying the accessible name "Take a note") expands the composer to reveal the Title textbox and the Close button; the user types a title and content, then closes the editor. Closing autosaves via POST /api/notes (memory-first, synchronous temp-file write) and collapses the editor. The new note then appears in the notes list under the "Others" heading (unpinned). The composer starts with class "collapsed" in the served HTML so the Title textbox and Close button are present at load but hidden until the editor expands; focusin on the composer expands it, closeComposer() collapses it after saving. The POST /api/notes route already existed in backend/server.js and is reused; accessible names ("Take a note", "Title", "Close", "Pinned", "Others") are copied verbatim from the specs.
